signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_not_violated : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  0 ≤ tolerance →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
      ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧
          Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack)

Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_not_contact : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
    ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧ Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack)
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_not_contact : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
    ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack ∧ Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack)
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible_iff_classified : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.feasible ↔
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated_iff_classified : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  0 ≤ tolerance →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
      (Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.violated ↔
        Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack)
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact_i:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact_iff_classified : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
    (Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact ↔
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack)
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.unresolve:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.unresolved_iff_classified : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.unresolved ↔
    ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧
      ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack ∧ ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.source_re:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.source_regions_pairwise_disjoint : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  0 ≤ tolerance →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval slack →
      ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧
            Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack) ∧
        ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧
              Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack) ∧
          ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack ∧
              Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack)

Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.source_regions_cover : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∨
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack ∨
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack ∨
        ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible tolerance slack ∧
          ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated tolerance slack ∧
            ¬Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact tolerance slack
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classific:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classification_total_exclusive : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ)
  (slack : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackInterval),
  (Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.feasible ∨
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.violated ∨
        Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact ∨
          Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack =
            Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.unresolved) ∧
    ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.feasible ∧
          Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack =
            Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.violated) ∧
      ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.feasible ∧
            Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack =
              Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact) ∧
        ¬(Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.violated ∧
            Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance slack = Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact)
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.positive_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.positive_tolerance_boundary_is_contact : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ),
  0 ≤ tolerance →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance { lower := tolerance, upper := tolerance } =
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.negative_:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.negative_tolerance_boundary_is_contact : ∀ (tolerance : ℚ),
  0 ≤ tolerance →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.classify tolerance { lower := -tolerance, upper := -tolerance } =
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.SlackClass.contact
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.invalid_i:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.invalid_interval_overlap_counterexample : Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.validInterval
      { lower := 2, upper := -2 } =
    False ∧
  Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.feasible 1 { lower := 2, upper := -2 } ∧
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.violated 1 { lower := 2, upper := -2 } ∧
      Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.contact 1 { lower := 2, upper := -2 }
signatures.Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budget_sl:
Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budget_slack_antitone : ∀ (budget earlier later : ℚ),
  earlier ≤ later →
    Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budgetSlack budget later ≤ Experiments.Pal24IntervalSlack.budgetSlack budget earlier
